notes.note: Inspected the retained image, its original capturedRevision and media.json historical-comparison evidence. It documents the earlier composer redesign and does not claim the current selector appearance. The shared ComposerChoice extraction changes current captions, Agent icons and scrolling geometry; those later changes are not represented by this historical comparison. Keep the original image and capture revision, without promoting it to current pixel evidence. Current real-component fixtures were separately rendered at 390/1440 in both themes and the long-engine hint browser tests passed.
